title: Redstone-Over Radio
description: &dNTM&r introduces &eRedstone-Over Radio&r, which is a system of sending redstone signals wirelessly. There are many ROR components which serve different purposes, from maintaining a certain amount of fluid in a tank to reading item amounts in containers.

The foundational components of this system are the ROR &6Transmitter&r and &6Receiver&r. As their name suggests, they can send and receive redstone signals. For them to be linked together, both need the same &eID&r.
